STEP 1 — goal: ground each of the four proposals in the frozen evidence before ranking. Read: the frozen bundle (E1-E14 for all four ideas; the behavioural/geometric blocks are largely shared, so the discriminating items are E5-E9 and E11).

Observations that decide the ranking:
- E6 (width-20 beam survival, 57439 test rows): every level-1 behaviour/geometry arm sits at or below the 0.065 target — l1_br 0.04671, l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363, successor_entropy 0.05122, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500; frozen baseline anchor is ~0.0555. So a pure "put the successor signal into the level-1 geodesic assignment" family is already measured and underperforms (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.055 < l1_br_euclid 0.062).
- E6 depth survival: l1_br (level 1 deterministic on behaviour) has gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068 — level 1 is perfectly preserved but the deep token is unresolvable; l1_br_euclid / l1_only 1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085. => any mechanism that lets behaviour dominate level 1 without bounding it kills the deep prefix, matching the rejected arms' l3_collision 0.549/0.943/0.960 vs baseline 0.2745 and level2_distinct_prefixes 4236/784/720 vs 7414.
- E7 teacher-forced NLL: l1_br T1=0.00 but T4=9.03; successor_geodesic_coarse T1=2.53/T4=0.77 vs resample T1=4.55. Behaviour-bearing position 1 is cheap to learn; the loss is entirely in deep positions, so a mechanism must keep behaviour influence on level 1 BOUNDED and item-specific rather than uniform.
- E5: successor concentration is extremely heterogeneous across items (top-1 mass 0.4375 lowest-entropy quintile vs 0.0543 highest; Spearman(entropy, top-1) = -0.973; support 2.8 vs 44.3). This is the single best grounding for a PER-ITEM behaviour weight (alpha_x from measured concentration) and against any single uniform global behavioural force.
- E11: same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067 — existing level-1 tokens carry only a thin behavioural signal, so the level-1 slot has headroom but not much.
- E8: K=16 gives 0.3106 anchor/target same-cluster vs 0.0822 at K=256 — coarse behavioural grouping helps in absolute terms, but the codebook size is frozen at 256, so this is a ceiling warning, not an admission rule.

Derived placement logic (not yet the final answer): shalcurv-cont-anchor-rq first (only proposal whose behaviour weight is item-specific and measured from E5's concentration spread, with a M=8 geometric shortlist that bounds behaviour to reordering — the exact safeguard against the E6/E7 deep-collapse mode); l1-geosuccdrift-rq second (successor-centroid coupling on codeword positions, cap derived from measured spacing, levels 2..L literally baseline; but it is a uniform full-codebook geodesic drift and it also makes level-1 assignment Poincare, the family that E6 measures at 0.055); brancurv-l1-rq third (specification cleanest and constants all measured, deep recursion exactly baseline, but the behaviour signal is one static scalar out-degree — E5 shows successor identity/concentration, not degree, is what stratifies behaviour, and dropping ||z|| from the level-1 assignment shifts the residual radial range); SGSA-RQ-2026 fourth (a fixed-curvature successor-anchor score on level-1 assignment with init-frozen normalizers and no gradient through the anchor — near-duplicate of the already-measured successor_geodesic_coarse/v2 family at 0.055/0.0546, i.e. direct counte

revidence in E6).

Open: final ordering of positions 2 and 3 (geo-drift vs brancurv) — resolved in favour of geo-drift because its coupling carries real successor information (E5-supported) whereas brancurv's does not.

STEP 2 — goal: finish the ranking and record the complete answer. Read: nothing new; used E5, E6, E7, E8, E11 of the frozen bundles plus the four specifications' own constants.

Final ground for each position:
1. shalcurv-cont-anchor-rq — item-specific behaviour weight alpha_x from a measured successor concentration (grounded in E5's 0.4375 vs 0.0543 top-1-mass spread), coupled in ONE score with geodesic residual distance over an M=8 geometric shortlist so behaviour can only reorder inside the geometric neighbourhood; kappa = 1/sigma^2 derived, no swept constant; shortlist is the explicit guard against the E6/E7 mode where behaviour dominates level 1 (l1_br gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068) and deep dispersion dies.
2. l1-geosuccdrift-rq — successor-centroid signal (E5-supported) genuinely coupled to a Poincare exp/log step on the level-1 codebook positions, cap derived from measured median codeword spacing, levels 2..L literally baseline; held back because it is a single uniform geodesic drift over the whole level-1 codebook and its level-1 assignment is the geodesic one E6 measures at 0.05500/0.05463, and its own risk list concedes the committed drift-free forward may not reflect the trained geometry.
3. brancurv-l1-rq — cheapest and cleanest (all constants measured, deep recursion exactly baseline, no extra loss/hyperparameter), but the behaviour is a single static popularity-adjusted out-degree scalar, which E5's heterogeneity (successor support 2.8 to 44.3 within the same catalogue) does not identify as the stratifying signal; it also drops ||z|| from the level-1 argmin, shifting the radial range the unchanged deep codebooks must quantize.
4. SGSA-RQ-2026 — ranked last on direct evidence: its score (normalised Poincare item-to-code plus successor-anchor-to-code, plain argmin, init-frozen D_item/D_anchor, no gradient through the anchor) is essentially the already-measured successor_geodesic_coarse family, E6 recall@10 0.05500 and v2 0.05463, both below l1_br_euclid 0.06207 and the 0.065 target; no element of it is new relative to that measurement.

Objection recorded: E6 caps every measured level-1 behaviour arm at 0.0621-0.0636, below the 0.065 target, and the programme allows one run and no ablation/seed arm, so no proposal here can be shown to have headroom above 0.065 from the frozen evidence; the ranking is therefore a ranking of least-bad risk of deep-collapse (l3_collision <= 0.35, level2_distinct_prefixes ~7414), not of demonstrated gain.
